t: The Zink Thebe indoor PIR sensor provides reliable automatic lighting control for various applications. This low-profile ceiling-mounted motion sensor offers a 360° detection angle and adjustable 10s to 15 min timer, making it ideal for commercial offices, corridors, or domestic utility rooms and garages. It also integrates easily with lighting circuits, HVAC systems, or security alarms.With adjustable sensitivity the detection distance can be configured to reduce false triggers. Its durable polycarbonate body ensures longevity, while adjustable time-on and dusk-to-dawn settings allow for energy efficient operation. The sensor is mains-powered with all necessary brackets and fixings supplied for straightforward installation.
